# Skill: test-design

## Use
This is the general test design helper. For Must-level behavior and Tier 1/Tier 2 changes, use `qa-test-design` first.

## Procedure
1. Read `docs/testing-strategy.md` and `docs/qa-governance.md`.
2. Map the slice to test layers.
3. Ensure QA-owned acceptance tests exist before Dev implementation.
4. Add technical unit/contract/integration test recommendations.
5. Update worklog and traceability.

## Output
A short test design note that complements the QA test matrix.
